title: Task-SEEG recordings from epilepsy patients performing a visual working memory task (Tian, Figshare 32189838)
description: Stereo-electroencephalography (SEEG) recordings from seven patients with drug-resistant epilepsy performing a visual working memory task. Intracranial depth electrodes were placed solely for clinical evaluation, and data were sampled at 2048 Hz in eight continuous recordings. The dataset supports investigation of the neural mechanisms of working memory, including hippocampal and frontal eye field activity. It is provided in BIDS iEEG format, de-identified, and without event files or electrode coordinates.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded with multi-contact depth electrodes (8-16 contacts, 0.8 mm diameter, 1.5 mm spacing) stereotactically implanted with robotic assistance, using a Nicolet EEG amplifier at 2048 Hz with an online white-matter reference chosen by the clinical team. Participants performed a visual working memory task.
